transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Hello, this is Grace Chen from Valley Dental Clinic, calling for Mr. Okafor. I'm calling to remind you of your appointment with Dr. Patel tomorrow, Thursday, at two fifteen.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Please note that our clinic has moved to a new address. We're now at 48 Riverside Drive, on the third floor of the Morton Building. Parking is available behind the building.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: If you need to reschedule, please call us at least twenty-four hours in advance to avoid a cancellation fee. Thank you, and see you tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Attention, passengers on Coastal Airways flight 382 to Lisbon. Due to a technical issue with the aircraft, this flight will now depart from Gate 27 instead of Gate 12. The new departure time is eleven forty-five.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: We apologize for the inconvenience. To thank you for your patience, passengers on this flight can collect a meal voucher at the customer service desk next to Gate 20. Please keep an eye on the departure screens for further updates.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: This is Mike Duncan with your morning traffic update on Radio 96. If you're heading downtown on Highway 9, expect delays of up to thirty minutes because of road work near the Station Street exit.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: The work is part of the city's bridge renovation project, which is scheduled to continue until the end of next month. Drivers are encouraged to use Lakeshore Road instead.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: And remember, the city's new express buses now run every ten minutes from the Northgate park-and-ride. Coming up after the break: an interview with the mayor about the new bike lanes.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Before we finish, a quick update on the customer survey. We received more than two thousand responses, which is our highest number ever.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Most customers are happy with our products, but many mentioned that our website is difficult to navigate on mobile phones. Now, I know the web team is already busy preparing for the holiday sale. But the holiday sale brings in forty percent of our online revenue.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: So I'd like each of you to read the comments this week and suggest one improvement we could make quickly. Please send your ideas to me by Friday.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Good afternoon, shoppers, and thank you for visiting Brookfield Home Center. For the next two hours only, all paint and painting supplies are twenty-five percent off.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Our paint experts are also offering free color consultations in aisle seven. Just bring a photo of your room. And don't forget: members of our rewards program get free delivery on any purchase over one hundred dollars. You can sign up at any checkout counter in less than a minute.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Welcome to the Hartley Chocolate Factory tour. My name is Olivia, and I'll be your guide for the next hour.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: We'll start in the history room, where you'll see the original machines used when the factory opened in 1921. Then we'll walk through the production area. For safety reasons, you'll need to wear one of the hairnets in the basket by the door, and please don't touch any of the equipment.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: At the end of the tour, everyone will receive a free box of our bestselling truffles, and our shop will be open if you'd like to buy more.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Good evening, everyone, and welcome to the annual Small Business Awards. Our keynote speaker tonight needs little introduction.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Fifteen years ago, Amara Diallo started a bakery in her own kitchen. Today, her company, Golden Crust, has thirty locations across the country and employs more than six hundred people. Ms. Diallo is also known for her mentoring program, which has helped over a hundred young entrepreneurs launch their own businesses.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Tonight, she'll be sharing what she's learned about growing a company without losing its character. Please join me in welcoming Amara Diallo.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Hi, Tom, it's Rachel. I'm calling about our trade show booth. I just got off the phone with the event organizers, and they've moved us from the main hall to the east wing. Apparently there was a problem with the electrical setup.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: I know you designed the booth for a much bigger space. Well, the east wing gets a lot of traffic from the coffee area.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Could you look at the floor plan I've just e-mailed you and let me know by tomorrow whether we need to change the display panels? Thanks.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Good morning, and welcome to the new employee training day. Before we start, there's been a small change to the agenda.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Mr. Ortiz, who was going to lead the data security session, is stuck in traffic, so his session will switch places with the one scheduled right after lunch.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Lunch will be served in the cafeteria on the ground floor, and you'll need your new ID card to get in. If you haven't picked yours up yet, please see me during the first break.

media.title: Free Shuttles to the Convention Center

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Good evening, and welcome to the International Logistics Forum. Tomorrow's sessions begin at nine at the convention center.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: For those of you staying here at the hotel, free shuttle buses will leave from the main entrance starting at seven thirty. Please note that the stop near the City Museum is closed for construction this week, so that line won't be running.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: If colleagues are arriving by plane tomorrow, let them know that their shuttle only runs every half hour. Finally, registration packs, including your badge, will be available at the convention center entrance.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Hi, this is Laura from Prime Auto Repair. Your car is ready to be picked up. We replaced the front brakes and changed the oil, as you requested. The total comes to three hundred and twenty dollars.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: We're open until six today, and from eight to noon tomorrow. Please remember to bring the claim ticket we gave you, so we can find your keys quickly. Thanks!

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Good morning, passengers. This is your conductor speaking. We're now approaching Millbrook, where we'll stop for about ten minutes while the crew changes. Passengers traveling to Portland should remain on board.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: The café car at the back of the train will reopen after Millbrook and will serve hot breakfast until ten. We'd also like to remind you that free Wi-Fi is available in all cars. The network name and password are printed on the back of your seat.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: In business news, the electronics maker Voltrix announced today that it will open a new research center in Melbourne next spring. The center will focus on battery technology and is expected to create about three hundred jobs, mostly for engineers and scientists.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Voltrix's chief executive said the company chose Melbourne because of its strong universities and the city's support for clean energy projects. Construction of the building, designed by local firm Arden Architects, began last month. Voltrix shares rose four percent following the announcement.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: OK, everyone, one last thing. As you know, we've been testing the new scheduling software in the Toronto office for the past two months. The feedback has been very positive. Staff say it saves them about an hour a week.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: So starting next month, we'll be using it in all our branches. I know some of you were worried it would be complicated. Well, the Toronto team learned it in a single afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Training sessions will be held next week, and you can sign up for one on the intranet.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Is your home office feeling cramped? At Northline Furniture, we specialize in space-saving desks and shelving designed for small apartments.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: This month, every desk comes with a free ergonomic chair. And our design team will visit your home at no cost to help you plan the perfect layout. Visit our showroom on Fifth Avenue or browse our full catalog online. Northline Furniture: make the most of every square foot.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Welcome to today's workshop on public speaking. I'm Daniel Webb. Over the next three hours, we'll practice techniques to help you feel more confident in front of an audience.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: First, I'll show you a short video of two presentations, one strong and one weak, and we'll discuss the differences. After that, each of you will give a two-minute talk on a topic of your choice. Don't worry: only the people in this room will see it.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: I'll record each talk so that you can watch yourself afterward. You'll find it's the fastest way to improve.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: And now for the weekend weather. A storm system moving in from the west will bring heavy rain and strong winds to the region on Saturday, with gusts of up to eighty kilometers per hour.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: As a result, the organizers of the Riverside Food Festival have decided to move all of Saturday's events indoors, to the Exhibition Hall on King Street.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Sunday looks much brighter, with sunshine and temperatures around twenty-two degrees. That's perfect for the festival's closing parade along the river. Stay tuned for the latest on road conditions.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Thank you all for coming to this year's end-of-year meeting. It's been an exceptional year. We launched three new products, opened our first office in Asia, and our customer satisfaction scores are the highest in the company's history.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: I know many of you worked long hours to make all of this happen. Our competitors said we couldn't do it in one year. Well, here we are.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: To show our appreciation, every employee will receive two additional vacation days next year. Human resources will send the details next week.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Attention, museum visitors. The museum will be closing in thirty minutes. We'd also like to remind you that this is the last week of our special photography exhibition, so if you haven't seen it yet, now is your chance.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Due to a water leak, the natural history floor is temporarily closed, and the dinosaur skeletons have been moved to the floor directly below it until repairs are completed.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: The gift shop on the ground floor will remain open for an additional fifteen minutes after closing.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Thanks for coming. As promised, I want to share the results of our employee benefits survey. As you can see on the chart, the most popular option was extra vacation.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Unfortunately, our budget doesn't allow us to offer that this year. However, the second most popular choice costs almost nothing to put in place, so we'll introduce it starting in March.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: We'll keep looking at the other options for next year. If you have any questions, my door is always open.
